description: The SKULLXBONES® Downtown Edition is built for the streets of Huntington Beach and beyond. Rolling on the SKULLXBONES® custom frame with 26" aluminum wheels, black stainless spokes, and slick ride cruiser tires, this model comes stock with the HBBC springer fork and ape hanger handlebars for that classic lowrider look. The single-speed coaster brake keeps things simple and reliable — just pedal, cruise, and own the block.Removable decals, a deluxe built-in kickstand, quick-release seat clamp, and a quilted gel quiet-ride seat complete the package — because style and comfort aren't mutually exclusive.Customize your ride with our bike accessories, or go further with our Electric Beach Cruisers.HBBC… Style. Quality. Value… Ride With Us!!Check out the entire SKULLXBONES® Downtown Edition collection! Visit our flagship store — HB Easyrider at 328 Main Street in Downtown Huntington Beach!
